module.title: Polar-wind field-aligned outflow with PWOM
entrypoints: PW/PWOM standalone: earth, earth_stet, earth_twostream, jupiter, jupiter_twostream, orig, saturn and restart
test1, test_pw, test_swpc_pwom variants and test_gm_ie_pw
#555 pwom-earth, pwom-earth-twostream, pwom-polar-wind, pwom-saturn, pwom-saturn-restart and the restart/species variants
module.expensive_path: Hundreds of independent 1-D field-aligned multi-ion hydrodynamic solves with implicit stepping and photochemistry, followed by interpolation of outflow to the GM inner boundary; field-line count and time window are runtime knobs.
module.rationale: PWOM is a distinct polar-wind code family with standalone and coupled cases. Coupled CIMI+PWOM decks are attributed to CIMI when CIMI is the graded kinetic physics, avoiding duplicate PWOM ownership.
excluded: IE potential and GM coupling routines (swmf-mit-coupling), except as dependencies in coupled decks
non-public external data not read by the selected PWOM cases
hazards: PWOM's implicit solver is sensitive to the exact restart cadence; preserve #555 windows.
The old swpc-pwom checks are historical evidence only; fresh references are generated in the pinned container downstream.
